name: ExLover
source:
Nidal (He/They) and Laine (She/Her) are two lovers and runaways living their lives and making ends meet on their own. But Reese - a shadow from Nidal's past - is getting married, and an invitation was sent to Nidal, with neither lover sure if this was on purpose. Upon receiving the letter, Nidal and Laine discuss their relationships with Reese and with their respective baggage in an attempt to figure out if they should attend.

This game is an entry into the Strawberry Jam 7 game jam.

[From [url=https://furriesmakinggames.itch.io/exlover]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
尼达尔（使用he/they代词）和莱恩（使用she/her代词）是一对离家出走的恋人，靠自己维持生活、勉强度日。然而，尼达尔过去的阴影——里斯——即将结婚，一封请柬也寄到了尼达尔手中。这究竟是不是有意为之，两人都拿不准。收到信后，尼达尔与莱恩开始谈论各自和里斯的关系，以及各自背负的心结，试着决定是否赴约。

本作是第7届Strawberry Jam游戏创作活动的参赛作品。

[摘自[url=https://furriesmakinggames.itch.io/exlover]Itch.io[/url]]
